# Tom Carlson — UGC Creator

> Tom Carlson is a Los Angeles-based UGC (user-generated content) creator and former engineer who produces video and photo content for health, wellness, fitness, sports and tech brands. He has created content for 100+ brands, including C4 Energy, True Classic, Harry's, Joymode, HackMotion and Brickell Men's Skincare.

Tom specializes in scroll-stopping hooks and conversion-focused CTAs for organic social posting and paid ad campaigns. Services include organic ads, paid targeted campaign content, script reading and voiceover, UGC photography, monthly retainers, and custom packages. Rates are provided upon request.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tomcugc.com/): Overview, brand list, and quick links to work, services and contact.
- [Work](https://tomcugc.com/work.html): Portfolio of UGC video examples (unboxings, reviews, demos, testimonial-style content) for named brands.
- [About](https://tomcugc.com/about.html): Background, approach, and content categories (health, wellness, fitness, sports, tech).
- [Services](https://tomcugc.com/services.html): Full service list, and an FAQ covering what UGC is, usage rights/whitelisting, industries served, and process.
- [Pricing](https://tomcugc.com/pricing.html): What drives UGC pricing (deliverables, usage rights, turnaround, retainers vs one-off), plus a pricing-focused FAQ. No public price list — rates are quoted per project.
- [Testimonials](https://tomcugc.com/testimonials.html): Client testimonials (in progress).
- [Contact](https://tomcugc.com/contact.html): Email hello@tomcugc.com, Instagram @tomcugc, TikTok @tomcugc.
